summary: BLOCKED. The botanical safety fix passes current-run checks. Authenticated gameplay and mobile acceptance remain unverified.

checks.finding: The two-question Quiz was not completed interactively.

checks.evidence: Headless Chrome opened http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?step=quest; live DOM showed Sleep Valley with Luna, HealthClues Realm with Lumi, and six “Sắp ra mắt” regions.
checks.finding: All eight regions remain visible, with only the approved two presented as playable.

checks.evidence: scripts/healthclues-owner-demo-preflight.mjs confirmed the loopback healthclues-owner-demo project, Auth, and Mailpit.
checks.finding: No authenticated region entry was exercised because this run prohibits database writes.

checks.evidence: scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs passed connected-path checks for both playable regions.
checks.finding: Walk-before-Talk timing and player, Pet, and NPC alignment were not observed in a current-run browser session.

checks.evidence: Daily Care focused and hydration scripts passed. HealthCluesRpgWorldHud.tsx renders the first three of all active goals, counts completion across the full set, and links to My Journey when more than three exist.
checks.finding: The five-goal versus three-card explanation has source support, but user-facing clarity and save, reopen, and reload behavior were not verified.

checks.evidence: WellnessEncyclopediaStation.tsx no longer calls botanical-advisor on open and filters Botanist items through Catalog recommendations.
checks.finding: NPC station, lesson, quiz, mini-game, and Boss interactions were not exercised.
Magic-link login, returning-player progress, and two-account isolation were not retested.

checks.evidence: A workspace-local, guest-only CDP audit attempted the three requested viewports but exited with “CDP timeout: Page.enable” before capture.
checks.finding: Current-run emulated screenshots and measurements for Quiz, preview, HUD, NPC, Journey, Daily Care, navigation, safe areas, and touch targets are missing.

checks.evidence: Live Gout, Sleep, and Digestion botanical GETs returned NO_REVIEWED_CONTENT and zero herbs; guest botanical POST returned 401. scripts/test-botanical-review-gate.mjs passed six topic cases and its no-automatic-call source check.
checks.finding: The previously observed unreviewed herbal instructions and automatic Botanist provider request are absent in the tested local build. Cross-account isolation remains covered by the separate unverified auth check.

checks.evidence: Botanical, Daily Care, discovery, region-layout, and RPG quest-board focused scripts passed; the current-run CDP audit timed out.
checks.finding: No authenticated browser runtime-error audit or full journey regression completed.

blocking_items: The current instruction prohibits database writes needed for fresh-account and progress-persistence testing.
The workspace-local Chrome CDP audit timed out at Page.enable, preventing reliable mobile emulation and interactive guest testing.
No reviewed eligible botanical entry is available to exercise Botanist Save or Equip.
prompt_for_antigravity: Đợt này chưa quan sát được lỗi sản phẩm mới; cổng thảo mộc hiện trả rỗng an toàn. Trong luồng Quiz → World Preview → Mailpit → vùng chơi → NPC → My Journey/Daily Care, hãy xử lý trở ngại kiểm thử trước: kiểm tra Chrome/CDP vì audit khách chỉ đọc trong D:\botly\App\.tmp dừng tại `CDP timeout: Page.enable`. Dùng profile và ảnh hoàn toàn trong D:\botly, không chạy nguyên bản script nào ghi ảnh vào thư mục riêng ngoài workspace. Sau khi CDP hoạt động, đo viewport thực bằng Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride ở 320×800, 390×844, 430×932; mở và kiểm tra Quiz, preview, HUD, NPC, Journey, Daily Care, dock, overflow, safe area, nút đóng và mục tiêu chạm. Đối chiếu HealthCluesRpgWorldHud.tsx với App/UI_UX_SPEC.md: ba thẻ Daily Care là ba mục tiêu đầu trong tổng số năm, bộ đếm dùng đủ năm và liên kết mở toàn bộ Journey. Chạy lại scripts/test-botanical-review-gate.mjs và các test Daily Care không gọi AI, không ghi DB. Lệnh hiện tại cấm ghi database, nên dừng trước tạo tài khoản, lưu check-in hay E2E có ghi; báo các ca xác thực, persistence và học trong vùng là BLOCKED thay vì suy ra PASS từ handoff hoặc báo cáo cũ.
next_test: Restore Chrome CDP access, then run a guest-only Quiz and World Preview audit with measured viewport dimensions and inspected captures at 320×800, 390×844, and 430×932.
release_readiness: BLOCKED for local playable-scope acceptance. Botanical safety passes; authenticated and mobile browser gates remain open. Production and clinical readiness require separate review.
